name: Twenty-year wellhead platform development and cost history (2006–2026)
aliases: Twenty-year wellhead platform development and cost history (2006–2026)
applications: Malaysia and Southeast Asia wellhead platforms
principle: A 20-year retrospective assembled from dated project, technology and cost evidence on Malaysian and regional wellhead platforms, recorded with sources and dollar years where published.

performance.metric: Operational history — Golok discovered (gas in multiple reservoirs)
performance.basis: OGJ reported that Belum, Golok, Maharani and Serampang found gas in multiple reservoirs in 2005; Murphy's 2005 10-K lists Golok among discoveries added in SK309/SK311.

performance.metric: Operational history — First gas from SK309/SK311 Sarawak Gas Project
performance.basis: Production commenced 17 September 2009 from natural gas fields in Blocks SK309 and SK311, supplied to the PETRONAS LNG Complex at Bintulu; Murphy 85%, PETRONAS Carigali 15%.
OGJ reported Belum, Golok, Maharani and Serampang found gas in multiple reservoirs in 2005; Murphy's 2005 10-K also lists Serampang among discoveries added.

performance.metric: Operational history — Gas production start for SK309/SK311 Sarawak Gas Project
performance.basis: Serampang is part of the multi-phase development whose first production started 17 September 2009, with gas supplied to the PETRONAS LNG Complex at Bintulu.

performance.metric: Operational history — PETRONAS decided not to award the Tembikai & Chenang small field RSC after competitive bidding
performance.basis: PETRONAS media release dated 25 January 2013 stated it would not proceed with the award and would not re-open the cluster for bidding.

performance.metric: Operational history — First oil from Tembikai field
performance.basis: Offshore Technology states oil production from the Tembikai oil field began in October 2015 from a separate development with a central processing platform and FSO; PETRONAS later stated first oil in June 2015.

performance.metric: Operational history — First ZEEPod installed and commissioned at TNAG
performance.basis: ZEE Engineering states the first ZEEPod was installed and commissioned in July 2019 for Vestigo Petroleum; MMHE/MHB delivered topside and substructure from its Pasir Gudang/West yard in a nine-month schedule.

performance.metric: Operational history — Tembikai gas pipelay completed
performance.basis: OGJ reported the 68-km 12-in subsea pipelay to the Berantai FPSO completed in July 2020; gas production was expected to commence in 2020.

performance.metric: Reliability — ZEEPod TNAG units in operation
performance.basis: ZEE Engineering delivered-units table lists ZEEPod No. 1 TNAG - VESTIGO, water depth 70 m, topside lifting weight 400 MT, status '5 Years Operation' (page undated, accessed 2026)

performance.metric: Operational history — West Patricia first oil
performance.basis: Murphy Sarawak Oil started first oil production from West Patricia in Block SK309 in May 2003, 40 km offshore Bintulu in 130 ft of water.

performance.metric: Operational history — West Patricia and Congkak combined production
performance.basis: Murphy's 2005 10-K reported about 13,500 net barrels of oil per day from West Patricia and Congkak, with 2006 output expected to decline 10-15% on PSC entitlement effects.

performance.metric: Operational history — Second West Patricia wellhead platform work started
performance.basis: Upstream reported in December 2011 that Murphy had started work on a new wellhead platform to boost capacity at West Patricia to handle more output from SK309/SK311.

performance.metric: Operational history — Water injection / capacity support works at West Patricia
performance.basis: Vantris Energy (formerly SapuraKencana) track record lists EPCIC of Patricia Satellite PT-SA and West Patricia WP-PA topside facilities for SK309/311, February to August 2013.

performance.metric: Operational history — FSO swap at West Patricia
performance.basis: Malaysia Marine Department notice 96/2026(T) advised that NEPTUNE MOON would arrive on 14 July 2026 to temporarily replace FSO CASPIAN SEA until 18 September 2026, while CASPIAN SEA sailed to Singapore for maintenance on 19 July 2026.

performance.metric: Reliability — share of SK309/SK311 oil production attributable to West Patricia
performance.basis: About 7,400 barrels of oil per day produced in 2012 in Blocks SK309/311, almost 75% at West Patricia (Murphy 2012 Form 10-K)

performance.metric: Operational history — HOA for gas sales signed
performance.basis: A Barrel Full chronology records a heads of agreement for gas sales signed in 2006, followed by FEED completion for phase 1 in 2007 and first gas in 2009.

performance.metric: Operational history — East Patricia gas discovery
performance.basis: Murphy announced the East Patricia discovery in SK309 on 12 June 2009 with about 230 ft of net gas pay in 89 ft of water, 23 miles from the Bintulu gas receiving facility; Murphy 60%, PETRONAS Carigali 40%.

performance.metric: Operational history — Gas sales agreement extended to September 2021
performance.basis: Murphy exercised its option in December 2012 to extend the PETRONAS gas sales agreement, lengthening the contract from 2014 to September 2021.

performance.metric: Operational history — Five new SK309/SK311 fields on production
performance.basis: Serendah, Patricia, South Acis, Permas and Merapuh were brought on production in the second half of 2013 through platforms and pipelines tied back to existing infrastructure.

performance.metric: Operational history — Murphy sold 30% of its Malaysian interests
performance.basis: Murphy completed sale of 20% of its Malaysian oil and gas interests in December 2014 and an additional 10% in January 2015, reducing its SK309/SK311 interest to 59.5%.

performance.metric: Operational history — PTTEP acquired Murphy's Malaysia business
performance.basis: PTTEP HK Offshore signed an SSPA on 21 March 2019 to acquire 100% of Murphy's Malaysian business for USD 2,127 million, including the SK309 & SK311 project; completion expected end Q2 2019.

performance.metric: Operational history — D28 Phase 1 conductor-supported platform installed offshore Sarawak
performance.basis: 2H Offshore completed concept, detailed design, transportation and installation in 35 m water for OceanMight on behalf of PETRONAS Carigali; jack-up rig installation used for both jacket and topside.

performance.metric: Operational history — D18 Phase 2 conductor-supported platform installed offshore Sarawak
performance.basis: 2H's eighth conductor-supported platform in Malaysian waters; installed in 35 m water, jacket and topside in the same campaign and handed over to drilling and completions.
Kikeh, Malaysia's first deepwater development, had been in production since 2007 (Murphy operations summary, 2013).

performance.metric: Operational history — East Patricia and Siakap North discoveries announced
performance.basis: Murphy announced East Patricia in SK309 (about 230 ft net gas pay, 89 ft water) and Siakap North in Block K (about 4,300 ft water, 80% Murphy) on 12 June 2009.

performance.metric: Operational history — Kakap-Gumusut full-field production startup
performance.basis: Murphy's 2014 10-K states the Kakap main production facility was completed and full-field production started in October 2014, with early production via a temporary tie-back to Kikeh from late 2012.

performance.metric: Operational history — SK314A and SK405B exploration commitments
performance.basis: Murphy's 2018 10-K records a 59.5% interest in SK314A (488 thousand gross acres; three exploration wells drilled 2015-2016) and a 59.5% working interest in SK405B acquired November 2017 (2,305 sq km, 10-50 m water depth).

performance.metric: Operational history — Kikeh deepwater gas-lift and Malaysia free cash flow
performance.basis: Murphy's 2018 annual report says the Kikeh DTU gas lift project was completed, with a field-wide subsea gas lift project next; Malaysia assets continued to generate free cash flow.

performance.metric: Reliability — Murphy company-wide total recordable incident rate trend
performance.basis: Murphy 2018 annual report states TRIR was unchanged from the previous year and that its safety record places it in the top quartile versus peers; no numeric rate given and this is not Malaysia-specific

performance.metric: Operational history — First Tarpon (cable-guyed caisson) used
performance.basis: Offshore Magazine 1999: the cable-guyed caisson known as Tarpon was first used in 1987; patents owned by Stolt Comex Seaway.
37 cable-guyed caisson minimal production platforms operating in Gulf of Mexico, West Africa and Indonesia (1999 article).

performance.metric: Operational history — Malaysian fleet sample installed
performance.basis: IJREST 2014 Platform X: 76.30 m water depth, 200 km shore distance, unmanned, PETRONAS operator, installed 2006.

performance.metric: Operational history — DIALOG acquisition of Tarpon IP and Malaysian company
performance.basis: DIALOG acquired entire equity in Tarpon Platform Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd and all assets of Tarpon Systems International II LLC including IP, 15 November 2023.

performance.metric: Operational history — Fleet size reported by DIALOG
performance.basis: DIALOG OTC Asia 2026 deck: Tarpon minimal field production system with over 60 installations worldwide.
Tarpon What We Do and DIALOG BPTEC 2025 deck: designed to API RP2A to withstand 100-year storm.
1999 Tarpon article: fatigue life of the system is a prerogative of the owner but generally three times the anticipated service life as a minimum.
IJREST 2014 paper Table 1: Tarpon monopod offshore East Peninsular Malaysia, unmanned, installed 2006; topside 196.10 T, substructure 800 T, water depth 76.30 m.
IJREST 2014: as-designed metocean displacement was 1.16 times the 0.114g response, equivalent to about 0.124g; seismic did not govern. Range of PGA models 0.01-0.114g.

performance.metric: Operational history — RAJA SFA PSC signed
performance.basis: PETRONAS (via MPM) and DIALOG Resources signed the RAJA Cluster Small Field Asset PSC on 5 December 2024.

performance.metric: Operational history — FDAP approved / FID reached
performance.basis: PETRONAS approved the field development and abandonment plan on 21 September 2026 at USD81 million FID.

performance.metric: Operational history — First commercial production expected
performance.basis: Borneo Post quoting PublicInvest: first commercial production targeted by end of the two-year development phase, implying around September 2028.

performance.metric: Operational history — DIALOG entry into upstream
performance.basis: DIALOG Annual Report 2026 key milestones: ventured into Upstream with Balai Cluster Fields in Sarawak.

performance.metric: Operational history — BJC SFA PSC participation
performance.basis: Annual Report 2026: 70% participating interest and operatorship of Baram Junior Cluster SFA PSC up to 2037 (offshore Sarawak).

Annual Report 2026 key events: installation of Salbiah wellhead platform offshore Miri, Sarawak, 25 March 2026; COO review calls it successful completion including fabrication, load-out, sail-away and offshore installation.

performance.metric: Operational history — Salbiah first gas expected
performance.basis: Annual Report 2026 executive chairman statement: development progressing with expected first gas in Q2 FY2027.

performance.metric: Operational history — Zuhal East WHP installed
performance.basis: Tarpon page records EPCIC completion but prints no date; DIALOG BPTEC/OTC decks list Zuhal East as a completed Malaysian installation at 42 m.
Tarpon Zuhal East page: unmanned platform with minimal manual intervention and minimum facilities; remote monitoring from SUPG-B.
Tarpon awarded EPC contract for four WHPs; project ran October 2011 to June 2012.

performance.metric: Operational history — WHP installation year per DIALOG decks
performance.basis: BPTEC 2025 deck project photos label Balai, Bentara, Spaoh and West Acis as 2012.
Tarpon Balai page: constrained time frame under nine months while adhering to safety and integrity principles.

performance.metric: Operational history — Tanjong Baram contract award
performance.basis: 2H awarded detailed engineering/procurement/fabrication/installation support/commissioning; installation planned 1H 2015.

performance.metric: Operational history — D28 Phase 1 WHP installed
performance.basis: March 2019 report of completed jackup installation offshore Sarawak.

performance.metric: Operational history — D18 Phase 2 WHP installed
performance.basis: May 2020 report of second platform of its kind installed by jackup for PETRONAS in Malaysia.
Offshore Magazine 2019: both substructure and topsides installed using a jackup drilling rig, a first for PETRONAS offshore Malaysia.
Petrofac and PETRONAS ordered the unmanned minimal facilities platform; first Sea Swift-type installation in Asia/Pacific; production planned for 2012.

performance.metric: Reliability — Fatigue-life sensitivity to site shift
performance.basis: Offshore Magazine 2012: moving platform a few kilometres could lessen fatigue life from 15 to three years, unacceptable; structure redesigned for 10-year minimum.
Offshore Magazine 2022: Sarawak Shell and partners took FID in August 2021; PETRONAS 2023 confirms two years from FID to first gas.
Brooke Dockyard completed fixed offshore structure works at Demak yard; event 1 Oct 2022.
PETRONAS: first gas on 22 August 2023.
PETRONAS 2023: designed unmanned and powered by solar and wind hybrid power energy system; less than 5 kW continuous generation.
Offshore Technology: discovered in the 1970s; about 150 vertically stacked Miocene sand reservoirs.
Offshore Technology project profile.
BPMT reviewed artificial lift technologies; ESP selected for additional capacity and reliability.
Offshore Technology: construction began 2018, completion expected 2020; WHP FEED/EPCIC awarded to Brooke Dockyard April 2017.
Offshore Technology: Bokor produced first oil in 1982; artificial lift reviewed in 2007 after decline.
The Star 2026 quote from PTTEP Malaysia asset country manager.

performance.metric: Operational history — FID for first operated Malaysian project
performance.basis: The Star: PTTEP made FID in February 2026.

performance.metric: Operational history — CPP EPC agreement signing
performance.basis: Brooke CPP EPC agreement signed 26 May 2026, witnessed by Sarawak Premier; completion targeted February 2028.

performance.metric: Operational history — MFDP price agreement awarded
performance.basis: MHB press release dated 3 March 2026.

MSOSH: discovered July 1970; AWT case study: discovered by CONOCO in July 1970.
MSOSH: first gas flowed December 1984; AWT case study: first commercial gas April 1984 — two dated sources with different months, both recorded.
AWT: drilling four new wells (1995), workover/evaluating T reservoir (1999), workover/testing T reservoir (2001); Revisit IV in 2004.
EnQuest RNS 10 Jun 2026: proposed acquisition of 30% non-operated PI in PM6-12 PSC including Duyong, Gansar and Resak.
EnQuest RNS 2026: PM6-12 production efficiency in excess of 90% in 2025.
OSTI: discovered by TK-2 in 1966 with 235 ft net oil sand and 16 ft wet gas sand.

performance.basis: OSTI: development drilling commenced in 1975 with 23 wells; appraisal wells 1973-1975.

performance.metric: Operational history — SK305 D30 first oil
performance.basis: A Barrel Full wiki: first oil from D30 field in 2010.

performance.metric: Operational history — Kinabalu WHP letter of award
performance.basis: Gulf Oil and Gas 11 Sep 2015: OceanMight LOA from Talisman, conditional on FDP approval and detailed design; completion expected before end Q2 2017.

advantages: Dated evidence keeps conflicting project costs side by side instead of reconciling them
limitations: Many field-level costs are not published with a dollar year; those are recorded as gaps

gaps.item: field-level capex and operating cost with a stated dollar year
gaps.reason: Most operator and contractor pages read do not publish dated field-level costs.
